entries.1540fcaf6540153e: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥11,895 million, a decrease of 8.2% from the previous fiscal year. Store Sales Business was ¥6,535 million, Mail-Order Sales Business was ¥5,219 million, and Wholesale Sales Business was ¥141 million.
entries.1fbc24a0cd238f60: A reportable segment of the company group that sells footwear, apparel, daily necessities and other goods through catalogs and the internet, centered on its original products. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥5,219 million. Its main products include 'SP-ON', a shoe that can be put on with the hands kept down (put on while standing), and it sold 120,000 pairs during the fiscal year ended March 2026.

entries.3f8411a436713e41: A reportable segment of the company group that operates the general discount store 'Kutsu no Hiraki', centered on shoes, and shoe specialty stores. Net sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥6,535 million. The general discount stores sell footwear as well as food, apparel, daily necessities and other goods, while the shoe specialty stores sell footwear. During the fiscal year ended March 2026, it opened five new shoe specialty stores, and as of March 31, 2026, it operated 18 shoe specialty stores in the Keihanshin area.
entries.4168690fd1529a43: The company recognizes that expansion of the shoe and footwear market, its core business, cannot be expected. Within this environment, it aims to have the best-selling shoe section in Japan by number of pairs sold at the Iwaoka Honten of the general discount store 'Kutsu no Hiraki,' and it continues to expand its stores centered on shoes, including operating 18 shoe specialty stores in the Keihanshin area as of March 31, 2026.
entries.438f5680080e8507: The fiscal year ended March 2026 is the final year of the '2026 Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal years 2024–2026).' As its basic strategy for the next fiscal year, the company has set out thorough low-cost management through fixed cost reduction and operational efficiency improvements, along with investment that leads to future growth, such as reviewing products and services, developing new markets and human resource development.
entries.50fc4cf664476f54: Shoes and daily necessities planned in-house
entries.53f767b573194ebd: It has an integrated structure spanning development, production and sales, mainly outsourcing the production of in-house planned and developed products overseas, with its consolidated subsidiary in Shanghai handling procurement, and sells through three channels: stores, mail-order sales and wholesale sales. It states that it develops products at prices that allow customers to buy easily while maintaining quality.
entries.5c18401002efeaac: The '2026 Medium-Term Management Plan (fiscal years 2024–2026)' places strengthening the development of in-house planned and developed products (original products) as its primary priority. For the next fiscal year, its basic strategies are 'thorough low-cost management' and 'building a foundation for the future.' Its policy is to work on shortening lead times through a review of the development structure and a shift to EC in the Mail-Order Sales Business, standardizing the shoe specialty store model and opening stores on an ongoing basis in the Store Sales Business, and increasing transactions with major retailers and strengthening ODM sales in the Wholesale Sales Business.

entries.813063a77b518d8a: Centered on shoes and footwear planned and developed in-house, it offers clothing, daily sundries, food products and other goods through general discount stores, shoe specialty stores, and catalog and internet mail-order sales, and also conducts wholesale sales to major retailers.

entries.9a0d8966a50bde75: The company started in 1961 in Kobe, manufacturing and selling shoe parts, and later turned to retailing shoes. It is listed on the Standard Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. As of March 31, 2026, consolidated employees numbered 234, and its one consolidated subsidiary is Shanghai Hiraki Fukukyaku Commercial Co., Ltd.
